paite: Aw ka nu nawi ne, ka unaupa bang hi lechin maw! Polam a ka hon muhleh, ka hon tawp ding; Ahi, kuamah in ahon musit kei ding uh.
english: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

paite: Nang ka hon pi ding a, ka nu inn sung ah ka hon lalut ding a, ama'n kei ahon hilh ding; uain namtui ka hon dawnsak ding a, ka theibuhfai tuining.
english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

paite: Akhut veilam ka lu nuai ah a-om ding a, akhut taklam in ahon kawi ding hi.
english: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

paite: K'on ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, ka it, hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

paite: Gamdai a kipan a hong tou hiai angaihnou tung a kingai kua ahia? Numei' Epul sing nuai ah ka hon phawng a; huai ah na nun nang ahon vei a, huai ah nang hon piangsak amah nauvei in a-om hi.
heading: La Gukna / Numeite
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

paite: Na lungtang a suai bang in, na ban a suai bang in kei hon koih in; itna lah sihna bang in ahat ngal a; han bang in agilou a; huai a kuangte meikuang TOUPA meikuang bang ahi uhi.
english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.

paite: Tui tampi in itna aphelh thei kei a, tui khangte'n atum thei kei hi; itna ziak in min a-inn a vante pe ding hitaleh, nakpitak a muhsit in a-om ding hi.
english: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

paite: Sanggamnu neu ka nei ua, nawi anei kei. Atungtang kigen ni in ka sanggamnu uh a ding in bang ka hih ding ua?
heading: Numei Sanggampate
english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

paite: Kulhbaang hileh bel, amah tung ah dangka insang neu khat ka lam ding ua; kongkhak hitaleh, amah sidar singpek in ka sungkhum ding uh.
english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

paite: Kulhbaang ka hi a, ka nawite huai a insang bang ahi uh; huchih lai in mi muanna musa bang in amit ah ka om hi.
heading: Numei
english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

paite: Baal-hamon ah Solomon in grephuan anei hi; kem mite kiang ah grephuan akhelsak a; huai a agah a ding in michih in dangka sangkhat ngen ahon tawi ding uh ahi.
heading: Pasal
english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

paite: Grephuan, kei a ahi a, ka ma ah a-om; aw Solomon, nang, sang na nei ding a, huai a theigah kemte'n zanih.
english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

paite: Nang huante sung a teng, na kithuahpihte'n na aw angai ua, huai hon zasak in.
english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

paite: Kin meng in, ka ngaihnou, gimlim mual tung a zuktal hiam sakhi tuailai hiam bang in om in.
heading: Numei
english: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
